tag.en: 🔁 Back again: last time it chipped
tag.vi: 🔁 Khách quay lại: lần trước bị tróc

occasion: You have been to this salon before.
constraints: Last time your polish chipped after a few days. Mention it early and ask the stylist to make it last. You are friendly if they apologise and explain how they will prevent it (for example a base coat and a top coat).
openingLine: Hi, it's me again! Last time my polish chipped after a few days. Can you make it last longer this time?
